title: Global Climate Finance Architecture
definition: The complex system of public, private, and alternative sources of financing—supported by bilateral, multilateral, and domestic mechanisms—designed to support mitigation and adaptation actions to address climate change.
importanceInUpsc: Central to GS Paper III (Environment/Economy) and GS Paper II (International Relations). Frequently tested via COP outcomes, institutional mandates (GCF, GEF), and the 'Common But Differentiated Responsibilities' (CBDR) principle.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Global Climate Finance Architecture.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
